newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Volume falls, index climbs at Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Volume falls, index climbs at Estonian bourse.

text.p: Volumes fell but the index climbed at Estonia's infant bourse on Monday, the Tallinn Stock Exchange said in a statement.
Overall market volume was almost 5.7 million kroons, down from 7.4 million kroons on Friday. The index nudged up by 0.48 percent to close at 96.29.

Market leader Hansa Bank was the most traded instrument as usual, with over three million kroons worth of its shares changing hands. The bank's share price closed at 92.30 kroons compared with 92.40 kroons on Friday.
